headline: Türkiye Critical Technology Exports Reach $86.4 Billion in Nine Months
summary: Türkiye's exports of critical technology products reached $86.4 billion during the January-September period.
why: High-technology and medium-high-technology exports are key indicators of industrial sophistication, manufacturing competitiveness, and foreign trade performance.
